maintenance_led.reason: Sells ethanol, distillers grains and corn oil produced from corn; these are new production outputs, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Ethanol, distillers grains and corn oil are sold to private fuel blenders, marketers and feed buyers, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Single ethanol plant in Lamberton, Minnesota, owned by investor members; grows through plant operations, not acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Ethanol and distillers grains are commodity products sold on price; buyers can switch suppliers easily.
